event_records.description: The simulation begins. The revised Q4 budget has been prepared but not yet submitted for approval.

cfo.name: CFO
cfo.persona_brief:
You are CFO.
The CFO pushed back on the original marketing budget, leading to an eight percent reduction. They have a decent working relationship with the CMO and meet weekly. They are aware the offsite agenda includes the campaign as a topic.

cmo.name: CMO
cmo.persona_brief:
You are CMO.
The CMO leads the marketing team and has revised the Q4 budget to eight percent below the original ask after the CFO's pushback. They have a decent working relationship with the CFO and meet weekly. They know the offsite agenda lists the campaign as a topic.

resolution.question: Will Ostara Foods' CFO approve the marketing team's revised Q4 budget before the leadership offsite on the 21st?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the CFO actually communicated approval of the revised Q4 budget to the CMO or marketing team before 2026-09-21T09:00:00+01:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
